notes: Thin-record mechanics enrichment for four globally shortest current mechanics footprints. Canonical identities, acquisition endpoints, and relationship identities are preserved; source-reported numeric values remain bounded evidence.

records.name: All Clear
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Strike Super. The user swings an arm to create a frontal sweeping energy wave that knocks the opponent away and can negate Ki Waves. The move can also be used while guarding; current Xenoverse 2-specific evidence describes the guard use as invulnerable for the duration. Source-reported damage is about 10% and is not treated as patch-independent.

records.name: Angry Hit
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Strike Super. The user teleports toward the targeted opponent and strikes them with both fists, knocking them down. Current Xenoverse 2-specific skill evidence describes the move as a single-hit, mid-range teleport attack with source-reported damage of about 20%.

records.name: Arm Crash
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Strike Super. The user pulls the right arm back and rushes forward with a lariat that breaks an opponent's guard on contact. Holding the input extends travel to about 1.5 times the base distance. Current skill documentation reports about 20% damage; the value is retained as source-reported rather than universal.

records.name: Audacious Laugh
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Other Super. The user laughs while a dark red-orange aura surrounds them; after a short delay the locked-on opponent is staggered and receives a movement-speed slowdown. The move is non-damaging and requires lock-on to an enemy.
